title: claude-audit-log-hook
desc: Claude Code PreToolUse hook: log ALL tool calls (async) to D:/GitHub/ai-audit.log for traceability
steps: PURPOSE: every tool call Claude makes is appended to a shared audit log. No blocking, no slowdown -- runs async.
SCRIPT: C:/Users/kiexp/.claude/hooks/audit-log.ps1. Reads stdin JSON, extracts tool_name and first non-null of command/file_path/pattern, writes timestamped line.
LOG FORMAT: 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss <short-cwd> [ToolName]> <command>'. short-cwd = first char of each ancestor component + dash + leaf dir name (e.g. D/G/p-personal-docs).
HOOK ~/.claude/settings.json: PreToolUse / NO matcher (fires for all tools) / async:true / powershell audit-log.ps1. No timeout needed (async).
COEXISTENCE: lives alongside kill-guard-hook in the same PreToolUse array. Kill-guard has matcher=PowerShell; audit-log has no matcher, so both fire for PowerShell (guard first, then audit).
REVIEW: tail D:/GitHub/ai-audit.log to see recent Claude tool activity across all projects.

requirements.cmd: wkappbot skill search audit log hook

author: claude
